limits: The collection is a vendor-selected success set, not a statistical sample.
Case savings are not Temper savings estimates.
No case exposes a full audited cost ledger with comparable lot size and process for Temper.
BAIC source presents 30→10 parts in Figure 3 and 35→12 independent parts in adjacent prose; '20 removed' agrees with the table but not the prose. It does not explain count boundaries.
NCR product and promotional demonstration use different counts and time boundaries.
Only Dynisco, CNH, and BAIC quantitative claims were checked against rendered primary PDF pages. All other case accounts were HTML-text reviewed only.
